items.q: When is a restaurant still a job?
items.a: When you own it and still have to cook every day. [[dan-martell]]: a business makes money whether you are there. If it does not, you have a job.

items.q: Why does he say under a million is a hobby?
items.a: That is the number he says out loud. He hedges in the next breath: the handoff is usually closer to **two million**, and a million can still be enough.
Admin, then delivery, then marketing, then sales, then leadership. Five hires. At a million he says you can afford them.

items.q: What counts as a business on this tape?
items.a: You go on vacation and someone else made the audience, had the sales conversation, and onboarded the buyer.
